Diamond and graphite have giant covalent structures of carbon atoms.
Which statement describes graphite?
A
It has a strong, rigid three-dimensional structure.
B
It has four strong covalent bonds between each carbon atom.
C
It has layers, which can slide over each other.
D
It has no delocalised electrons so does not conduct electricity.

options.label: A
options.text: It has a strong, rigid three-dimensional structure.

options.label: B
options.text: It has four strong covalent bonds between each carbon atom.

options.label: C
options.text: It has layers, which can slide over each other.

options.label: D
options.text: It has no delocalised electrons so does not conduct electricity.
